title.zh: U4 attempt4 窗口前置：开窗前 GPU 基线 + 球轮廓 authoring dump 工具（离线、零 GPU；自检复现 attempt3 观测集，发现 v2 冻结必失败）
title.en: U4 attempt4 window preparation: pre-window GPU baseline + scene-a sphere-outline authoring dump tool (offline, zero GPU; self-check reproduces the attempt3 observation set and records that the signed v2 freeze fails)

intent.zh: 双签前置两件：①开窗前用只读 nvidia-smi 测三点基线并算 floor（材料内不含基线，须先签）；②在 scripts/authoring（离线 authoring 例外区）实现球轮廓 dump 工具并自检：精确 f32 重放两形态、逐实体清单 + sha、两次运行字节一致、产物 sha 独立复核、产品链零调用。自检必须复现 attempt3 观测集（cam1 183 px / 73 ULP；flags aa2 臂 172 px / 91 ULP；cam0=0）。同时把 criterion v2 冻结步的两个硬事实入证：§2 轮廓带谓词只覆盖 9/183（aa2 18/172）；§3 精确极值 B 重算 512 ULP > 已签 128（2048/512 于带集）。判据处置不由 Arch 决定，窗口在裁决前不开。
intent.en: Two prerequisites for the double-sign: (1) a pre-window three-point read-only nvidia-smi baseline with the derived floor; (2) an offline authoring dump tool for the scene-a sphere-outline lists with a full self-check (exact f32 replay of both association forms, per-entity lists + sha256, two byte-identical runs, independently re-verified outputs, zero product-chain usage). The self-check must reproduce the attempt3 observations (cam1 183 px / 73 ULP; flags aa2 arm 172 px / 91 ULP; cam0 = 0). It also records two criterion-v2 freeze facts: the section-2 outline predicate covers only 9/183 (aa2 18/172) affected pixels, and the section-3 exact-extreme B recomputation is 512 ULP > the signed 128. The criterion disposition is not Arch's call; the window stays closed until it is decided.

acceptance: baseline-pre-window.txt：三点原始 nvidia-smi（free/used/util/timestamp）+ floor = min(free) − 3072 = 5328 MiB + 窗口时复测规则；只读、零 GPU 负载。
authoring 工具在 scripts/authoring/（author-scene-a-sphere-outline.ps1 + .py 两文件），pinned 环境与上游身份由包装脚本复核，fail-closed，产物只写 -Out；产品构建/测试/门禁/产品脚本零调用（grep 证明）。
自检 PASS：S5 射线 256/256 位级、form A 对参考 747/747（aa2 745/745）位级、form B 受影响 183 px / 73 ULP（aa2 172 px / 91 ULP）= 与 attempt3 一致、cam0=0、两次运行产物逐字节一致、sha256 独立复核通过。
outline-replay-findings.txt：v2 §2 谓词覆盖 9/183 与 18/172、§3 B 重算 512/2048 的精确数字与结论；窗口计划 §6/§7 改写（基线先行 + freeze 运行 authoring 类 pinned-Python 工具明示）；不裁决、不改判据/参考/内核。
note: Arch 2026-10-31 注册（零 GPU；不声明 gpu 资源以免被 in_progress 窗口卡锁住）。自检发现按已签 criterion v2 原样 attempt4 冻结步必失败（谓词覆盖不足 + B 重算超 128），只出事实与材料，不自行裁决；窗口保持不开。
